prompt:
I've been given some raw analyst research notes for Ping An Insurance (stock code 02318) saved somewhere under the research folder in our workspace. The notes include several possible prediction ideas our team was considering.

I need you to go through those notes, pick the best prediction idea that is actually publishable (some of the ideas are too vague or can't be verified from public data — throw those out), and then prepare a complete Gougoubi prediction market proposal from it.

Please save the final proposal as **gougoubi_proposal.json** and also produce a **gougoubi_proposal.md** human-readable summary alongside it.

We are NOT submitting on-chain today — just prepare the full draft. The proposal needs to be complete enough that someone could submit it immediately without editing.
